definitions.gloss: to look out on, to face

examples.japanese: {望|のぞ}み{通|どお}りになった。
examples.english: It turned out as I wished.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}もが{幸|しあわ}せな{生活|せいかつ}を{望|のぞ}んでいる。
examples.english: Everyone hopes for a happy life.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}を{望|のぞ}む{部屋|へや}。
{山|やま}を{望|のぞ}む{高台|たかだい}に{立|た}つ。
examples.english: To stand on a hilltop overlooking the mountains.

examples.japanese: ホテルの{窓|まど}から{富士山|ふじさん}を{望|のぞ}むことが{出来|でき}る。
examples.english: You can see Mt. Fuji from the hotel window.

notes:
{望|のぞ}む has two main meanings: to desire/hope for, and to look out on.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle for the object of desire or view

SENSE 1 - DESIRE:
- {平和|へいわ}を{望|のぞ}む: to desire peace
- {成功|せいこう}を{望|のぞ}む: to hope for success
- {望|のぞ}み{通|どお}り: as desired, as wished

SENSE 2 - VIEW:
- {海|うみ}を{望|のぞ}む: to overlook the sea
- {山|やま}を{望|のぞ}む{部屋|へや}: a room with a mountain view

RELATED:
- {望|のぞ}み: hope, wish (noun)
- {希望|きぼう}: hope, wish (more common)
- {願|ねが}う: to wish, pray

FORMAL USAGE:
お{望|のぞ}み{通|どお}り and お{望|のぞ}みでしたら are polite expressions meaning "as you wish" and "if you desire."
